name: neck-press-barbell
title: Neck Press: Barbell
primer: This is an advanced exercise for chest strengthening.
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Grasp the bar a little wider than shoulder width apart.
Raise the barbell above your body and move it to the top of your chest, near your neck. This is your starting position.
Lower the bar down so it just touches the top of your chest.
Raise the bar until your arms are fully extended and your elbows are locked.
